review_stdout: Original reviewer stdout remains with the principal and was not overwritten. This file records the baseline hashes and the principal's summarized disposition only.

accepted_findings.summary: BallLauncher.try_launch calls RicochetBall.set_return_target, but the main-side RicochetBall had lost the branch return-target API and return behavior.
Spawn clearance and trajectory preview used base ProjectileConfig, so run radius and speed rewards did not match actual launches.
Victory overlay did not pause the tree, and the RunController restart handler needed to ignore echoed input while the controller remains active during pause.
RunRoot progress/status labels overlapped Main's existing HUD in the upper-left corner.

rejected_or_preserved_contracts: Restarting the run from RunController is intentional.
Clearing RunBuild on death is acceptable because the run ends.
Damage 1 multiplied by 1.25 still rounds to 1; do not rebalance.
ImpactSpark lifespan 0.18 is visual and was not treated as a gameplay defect.
UpgradeOffer pause/input behavior was confirmed by the principal.
